end.summary:
Aryan practised distinguishing a point, line segment, line and ray by endpoints and arrows.
They answered 4 of 5 attempts without help.
They identified line segments by two endpoint dots and lines by arrows in both directions.
They described rays as having one endpoint and extending in one direction.
Teach-back was not passed; no misconceptions were recorded.
end.parentNote: Aryan practised identifying figures using endpoint dots and arrow directions. They explained that a line segment has two endpoints, a line has arrows in both directions, and a ray has one endpoint and one direction; these explanations were used correctly during the lesson. At home, ask them to draw one example of each figure and label the endpoints and arrows.
